name: VoiceFlow
subtitle: Dictation that lands in any text field.
description: VoiceFlow for iPhone: an AI dictation app plus a keyboard that inserts what you say straight into any app.

apps.name: VoiceFlow
apps.subtitle: Dictate anywhere on iPhone.
apps.localizedDescription: Tap Dictate on the VoiceFlow keyboard, talk, tap Done: the cleaned-up text appears at the cursor. Groq Whisper transcription with AI cleanup, custom vocabulary, translation, and a local history. Bring your own API key.

versions.localizedDescription: Keyboard sessions: dictation inserts inline, no clipboard.

privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: VoiceFlow needs the microphone to transcribe your speech, including while the VoiceFlow keyboard is in use.
